summary: User asks if Temporal has a visual/graphical workflow designer tool similar to Camunda for designing workflows graphically and generating code. The Temporal team confirms no official tool exists but mentions community efforts like FalconFlow.
userImpact: Users seeking visual workflow design capabilities must rely on manual code writing or community tools, as Temporal offers no official graphical designer.
workaround: Use community tools like FalconFlow or design workflows directly in code
resolutionDetails: Closed as a discussion topic rather than an actionable issue. No official visual designer exists; users are directed to the public Slack for feature discussions.
keyQuote: There is no visual tool like that that's built by the Temporal team. There may be community-led efforts or tools for this
